DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通についてのお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will hear your traffic-related report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、自転車が赤信号で進むのを見ました。横断中の人が立ち止まっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車の赤信号進行と歩行者の反応を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I saw a bicycle go through a red light. A person crossing stopped walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the bicycle running a red light and the pedestrian's response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの交差点でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の近くです。短い間隔で信号が二つあり、名前を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅近くの二つの信号で名称が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near the station. There are two lights close together, and I do not remember the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the name is unknown and there are two nearby lights near the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの地図で、お歩きになった道を示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you show the route you walked on this map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅からこの道を来ました。店のある最初の信号ではなく、川の手前の方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で川の手前の交差点を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came from the station along this road. Not the first light by the shop, but the one before the river.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the intersection before the river on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この交差点ですね。時刻と自転車の進んだ方向を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This intersection. Tell me the time and the bicycle's direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後五時十分ごろでした。自転車は橋の方へ進みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目撃時刻と橋へ向かう進行方向を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: About five ten in the afternoon. The bicycle went towards the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the sighting time and direction towards the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 接触や、転倒は見られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did you see contact or anyone falling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも見ていません。歩行者が止まって、自転車がその前を通り過ぎました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 接触転倒はなく通り過ぎたと目撃範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I saw neither. The pedestrian stopped and the bicycle passed in front of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain you saw it pass without contact or falling, within what you witnessed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と状況が分かりました。ご協力ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand the location and situation. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの二通を、それぞれお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending these two separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ会社の担当者宛てです。一つの封筒にまとめて送ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一会社宛て二通を一つの封筒へまとめたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are addressed to people at the same company. Can I send them together in one envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to combine two letters to the same company in one envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まとめられます。中の二通に宛名を書いて、外の封筒に会社の住所を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can. Address both inside, and write the company's address on the outer envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部署は同じです。それぞれの担当者の名前を、中の封筒に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中の封筒に担当者名を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are in the same department. I will write each person's name on the inner envelopes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will write each person's name on the inner envelopes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外の封筒の厚さを測ります。配送の記録は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will measure the outer envelope's thickness. Do you need delivery records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。書類が着いたか分かる方法にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配送の追跡を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I want a method that lets me know whether the documents arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request delivery tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの追跡付きの方法をご案内します。重量と料金はこの表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can offer this tracked method. The weight and price are shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この方法にします。二通とも入っているか、封をする前に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提示方法を選び封前に二通の同封を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I choose this method. I will check both letters are inside before sealing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the offered method and check both letters are enclosed before sealing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二通、入っていますね。ふたを閉じたらお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both are inside. Once you close it, we will accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 閉じました。追跡の番号がある控えを、仕事のファイルに入れておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封を終え控えの保管先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have closed it. I will keep the receipt with the tracking number in my work file.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish sealing and say where you will store the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが控えです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your receipt. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返済予定表についてのご質問ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your question is about the repayment schedule, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。毎月一万五千円と聞いていましたが、初回だけ一万八千円になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 毎月額と初回額の違いを予定表で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was told fifteen thousand yen each month, but only the first payment says eighteen thousand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between regular and first payments on the schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 初回の欄を拝見します。内訳の説明はお受けになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the first-payment section. Has the breakdown been explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。二回目からは一万五千円なので、最初の三千円の違いを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二回目以降との三千円差の内訳説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. From the second it is fifteen thousand, so I want to understand the first three-thousand difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the breakdown of the three-thousand difference from later payments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約担当へ確認します。初回の利息の計算期間が、通常の月と違うかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the contract staff. The first interest calculation period may differ from a normal month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。初回にも一万五千円だけ用意すればいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初回の準備額を誤解していたと担当確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I thought I only needed fifteen thousand for the first payment too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the mistaken first-payment preparation amount and ask staff to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認できました。この予定表の初回は、借入日から最初の返済日までが長く、その分の利息が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I checked. For this schedule, the period from borrowing to the first repayment is longer, so the interest for that period is included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この日付からここまでの期間ですね。初回は一万八千円を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 借入から初回返済までの期間を読み初回一万八千円準備を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The period from this date to here. I will prepare eighteen thousand for the first payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the borrowing-to-first-repayment period and decide to prepare eighteen thousand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。その次は、ここにある日付と金額をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. For the following payment, see this date and amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二回目の日付と一万五千円も確認しました。家計の予定には、初回だけ別の額を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二回目の日付と金額を確認し家計に初回別額を反映する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the second date and fifteen thousand too. In my household budget, I will put a different amount for the first payment only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the second date and amount and reflect the first different amount in your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お確かめいただきました。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お肉のご注文でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to order meat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明日の料理教室で使う鶏肉を、二百グラムずつ六袋に分けてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料理教室用の鶏肉を二百グラム六袋で注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. For tomorrow's cooking class, please split chicken into six bags of two hundred grams each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Order six two-hundred-gram chicken bags for a cooking class. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 合計は一・二キロですね。どの部位をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: One point two kilograms in total. Which cut?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もも肉です。皮は付いたままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: もも肉で皮付きと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thigh, with the skin left on please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify thigh with skin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 明日ご用意できます。袋ごとに重さの表示を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can prepare it tomorrow. Each bag will have a weight label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。午前十時に来ますが、どこで受け取ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌日十時の受取場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That helps. I will come at ten in the morning. Where should I collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to collect tomorrow at ten. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この精肉カウンターです。受取りまで冷蔵しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This meat counter. We will keep it refrigerated until collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで受け取ります。袋の大きさは、この保冷バッグに六つ入りそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 精肉カウンター受取を了承し保冷バッグへの収納を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will collect here. Will all six bags fit in this insulated bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept collection at the meat counter and ask about fitting them in your insulated bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この小さい袋なら入ります。保冷剤を入れる分も空けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: These small bags will fit. Leave room for ice packs too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。名前は森です。もも肉二百グラムを六袋、明日十時にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前と数量日時をまとめ予約する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. My name is Mori. Six bags of two hundred grams of thigh for tomorrow at ten, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarise name, quantity and date/time to reserve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文を承りました。明日、お待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Order accepted. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 観察会にご参加ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you joining the observation event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。池の魚を見たいのですが、ここからは空の反射ばかり見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水面反射で魚が見えない困り事を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to see the pond fish, but from here I only see the sky's reflection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the water's reflection prevents seeing fish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 少し横へ移ると見やすくなります。日陰の石の所を試してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Moving a little sideways helps. Try the stone in the shade.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 石の所まで来ると、魚の形が見えます。柵の内側のままでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日陰へ移った見え方と柵内の観察を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: From the stone I can see the fish shapes. Should I stay inside the fence?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the view after moving to shade and observing inside the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、そのままご覧ください。今、右の水草の下に集まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, stay there. They are now gathering under the water plants on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見えました。模様のある魚は、こちらの観察表のどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 魚の模様と観察表の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see them. Which fish on this observation sheet matches the patterned one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how the fish's markings match the observation sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 背中の形を比べると、この写真が近そうです。種類は担当が後で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Comparing the back shape, this photo looks closest. The person in charge will explain the species later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今は特徴を記録します。赤い線があることも書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 種類断定を待ち赤い線の特徴を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will record features now. I will note the red line too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for species confirmation and record the red-line feature. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 観察表には見た場所も書けます。池のどの辺でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can record the location too. Where in the pond was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口から見て右側の水草の下です。次の説明の時に、この記録を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 魚の場所を記し担当説明へ記録を持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Under the plants on the right when looking from the entrance. I will show this record at the next explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the fish's location and take the notes to the staff explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よく見えましたね。説明は木陰で始めますので、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You saw it well. The explanation will start in the shade of the trees; please come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちの列車についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the train you are waiting for here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。放送が柱の裏では聞こえませんでした。今入ってきた列車は北町行きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞こえなかった放送の列車行先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I could not hear the announcement behind the pillar. Is the train that just arrived for Kitamachi?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the train destination from the announcement you could not hear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の列車は途中の南町までです。北町行きは、その次になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This train only goes as far as Minamimachi on the way. The Kitamachi train is next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南町で乗り換えると、先に北町へ着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 南町乗換と北町直通の到着順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Would changing at Minamimachi get me to Kitamachi earlier?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which arrives first: changing at Minamimachi or the direct Kitamachi train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日はこの後の直通の方が先に着きます。六分後に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today the direct train after this arrives earlier. It comes in six minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら直通を待ちます。行先表示は先頭だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直通を選び車両の行先表示位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will wait for the direct one. Is the destination display only at the front?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the direct train and ask where the destination is displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車両の横にもあります。「北町」と出るのをお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is on the side too. Check that it says “Kitamachi”.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。放送が聞こえるよう、この柱から少し離れて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 柱から離れて放送を聞ける位置へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will move a little away from this pillar so I can hear announcements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move away from the pillar to hear announcements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 黄色い線の内側で、前の方へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Move towards the front, staying inside the yellow line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここなら表示も見えます。北町行きが来るまで、この位置で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を見える位置で北町行きを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see the display here too. I will wait here for the Kitamachi train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for Kitamachi where the display is visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。よい旅を、いってらっしゃい。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貸出しのパネルを取りにいらしたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come for the loan display panels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。作品展用に四枚です。車に二枚ずつしか載らないので、二往復します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示パネル四枚を二往復で運ぶ事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, four for an exhibition. My car holds only two, so I will make two trips.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you will transport four display panels in two trips. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約は四枚ですね。残り二枚はこちらに置いておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Four reserved. We can keep the remaining two here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。最初の二枚を積む時、立てたまま運んでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の二枚の運ぶ向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. When loading the first two, may I transport them upright?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the transport orientation for the first two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このパネルは、布を挟んで横に重ねてください。持ち手はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: For these panels, lay them flat stacked with cloth between. The handles are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毛布を持ってきました。金具が当たらないように間に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毛布で金具の接触を防ぐ準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought a blanket. I will put it between so the metal fittings do not touch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the blanket preparation to prevent metal contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金具はこの袋にまとめました。組立ての説明書も入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The fittings are together in this bag, with assembly instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金具と説明書は最初に持っていきます。残りを取りに来るのは二十分後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金具説明書を先に持ち二十分後の再訪を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take fittings and instructions first. I will come back in twenty minutes for the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take fittings and instructions first and state a twenty-minute return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、二枚はこの台車に残しておきます。お戻りになったらお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will leave two on this trolley. Let us know when you are back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一度展示室で荷物を下ろし、戻ってから残り二枚を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示室で下ろして残りを受け取る順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will unload at the exhibition room first, then return for the remaining two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm unloading at the exhibition room before returning for the rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。運転にお気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: リハビリへ行く準備中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you preparing to go to rehabilitation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。持ってきた靴を履こうとしたら、右足だけきつくて入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右足だけ靴に入らない状態を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I tried my shoes, but only my right foot is too tight to fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report only the right foot does not fit the shoe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に履かず、足の様子を見せてください。いつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not force it. Let me see your foot. Since when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝気づきました。昨日は同じ靴を履けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝気づき昨日は履けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed this morning. I could wear the same shoes yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed this morning and could wear them yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 痛みはありますか。リハビリ担当にも状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Any pain? I will tell the rehabilitation staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 痛みはありませんが、足の甲が張る感じです。予約には間に合わなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みなし甲の張りと予約遅れの心配を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: No pain, but the top of my foot feels tight. I may not make my appointment on time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain no pain, tightness on top of the foot and worry about lateness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約先へこちらから連絡します。先に足の状態を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will contact your appointment provider. First we will check the foot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。左の靴は脱いで、ここで待っていればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左靴を脱ぎ座って待つ対応を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Should I remove the left shoe and wait here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check removing the left shoe and waiting seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、座ったままでお待ちください。靴を脱ぐのはお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, stay seated. I will help remove the shoe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。運動を始めていいか、担当の方にも聞いてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運動可否を担当へ確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Please also ask the person in charge whether I may begin exercising.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check whether exercise is permitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その点も確認します。まず足を拝見しますね。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check that too. Let me first see your foot. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 建物の入口のことでご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your enquiry is about the building entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今朝、共用入口の錠の周りに新しい傷があるのを見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共用入口の錠の新しい傷を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This morning I found fresh scratches around the communal entrance lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report new scratches around the communal entrance lock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 扉は開いたままですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉まっています。ただ、鍵を差しても回りにくくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉扉と鍵が回りにくい状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is closed, but the key is now hard to turn when inserted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the closed door and hard-to-turn key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理者へは連絡されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 管理会社に連絡し、担当者が来るそうです。傷の写真は撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理会社の連絡と写真撮影を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I contacted the management company, and someone is coming. I photographed the scratches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you contacted management and took photographs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 前に異常がなかった時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know when it was last normal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨夜九時に帰った時は普通に開きました。今朝七時に傷を見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正常だった昨夜九時と発見した朝七時を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It opened normally when I returned at nine last night. I found scratches at seven this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give nine last night as normal and seven this morning as discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 建物へ入った人や、作業中の人を見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did you see anyone enter or working there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 誰も見ていません。修理前に見ていただく必要があるか、管理会社にも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人物目撃なしと修理前確認の必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I saw no one. I also want to tell management whether you need to inspect before repairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you saw no one and ask if inspection before repair is necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対応を担当に確認します。写真をお持ちくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the response with the person in charge. Thank you for bringing the photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the envelope's address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先方からもらった返信用封筒ですが、郵便番号の欄が空いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信用封筒の欠けた郵便番号を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is the return envelope from the other party, but the postal code field is blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a missing postal code on a return envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所は最後まで印刷されていますね。番号を調べて補えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The full address is printed. We can look up and add the code.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市名と町名はこちらです。建物の名前だけで調べるのではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 町名まで示し住所で番号を調べることを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are the city and town names. So it is not searched by building name alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show through the town name and confirm looking up by address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、住所で確かめます。こちらの番号になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct, we check the address. This is the code.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を書きました。この返信用の封筒には、自分の住所も書き足しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号を補い差出人住所の記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written it. Should I add my own address on this return envelope too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the code and ask about the sender's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 裏面の差出人欄へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write it in the sender section on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏に書きました。切手はすでに貼ってありますが、この厚さでも足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏面記入後に貼付切手で料金が足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote it. Stamps are already attached; is the postage enough at this thickness?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After writing the back, ask whether attached stamps cover the postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 重さを測ります。貼ってある料金で送れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will weigh it. The attached postage is enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、このまま差し出します。番号を補ったので、次の返信にも控えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補った番号を控え封筒を差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will send it as it is. I added the code, so I will note it for the next reply too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the added code and hand in the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take it. Thank you.
